title: Charles Hall's Air Force service records
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Charles Hall's Air Force service records, about 1960s at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Bull BS. He was in the Air Force and I have the record. You have his DD214,

plain: Charles Hall is a man who says he served with the US Air Force in the 1960s at the Nevada test site and Area 51, a secret Air Force base in Nevada. The podcast host Jesse Michels says that when people doubt Hall was ever there, he answers that he has Hall's DD214, the official US military discharge record, proving Hall was in the Air Force.
